title: Decoupled energy-stable Runge-Kutta schemes of arbitrary order for the anisotropic phase-field dendritic crystal growth model
summary: In this paper, we construct an arbitrary-order scheme for the anisotropic phase-field dendritic crystal growth model by introducing a time dependent auxiliary variable. By employing an algebraically stable Runge-Kutta method, the proposed scheme satisfies an unconditional discrete energy dissipation law. To reduce the computational cost, a matrix diagonalization technique is applied to the coupled elliptic system at each time step.
